title: Premium vs Coverage Value Ratio
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lemonade:policy coverage_usd=* premium_annual_usd=*
| eval cost_per_1k=round(1000*premium_annual_usd/coverage_usd,2)
| sort - cost_per_1k
| table policy_type coverage_usd premium_annual_usd cost_per_1k
description: Calculates annual premium dollars per thousand dollars of dwelling coverage for each policy type.
value: Cost-per-coverage helps compare Lemonade quotes against broker alternatives on equal footing.
implementation: Export policies with `coverage_usd` and annualized premium, then rank by cost per thousand covered.
visualization: Bar chart of cost per thousand coverage by policy type.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how expensive each home policy is relative to the amount of coverage you actually have.
